## Date Picker (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/date-picker)

DatePicker and DateRangePicker with built-in presets, min/max bounds, clearing triggers, and standard YYYY-MM-DD form submissions.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/date-picker/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import {
  DatePicker,
  DateRangePicker,
  defaultDateRangePresets,
  type DateRange,
  type DateRangePreset,
} from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

Use `DatePicker` or `DateRangePicker` when users need to select dates within forms, query bars, or filter headers without taking up permanent layout space:

- Setting invoice due dates, quotation validity periods, or purchase order delivery dates.
- Selecting custom reporting intervals or quick presets (such as "Last 30 days" or "This month") in financial analytics.
- Capturing personal dates like date of birth using year/month dropdown navigation.

When choosing between date components:
- Use [Calendar](/ui/docs/components/forms/calendar) directly when you want the month grid permanently visible inline on the page (such as a resource booking calendar or dispatch dashboard).
- Use `DatePicker` for selecting an isolated point in time (e.g. `dueDate`).
- Use `DateRangePicker` when querying date spans bounded by start and end dates.
- Use [Input](/ui/docs/components/forms/input) with `type="date"` if minimal JavaScript bundle size on legacy mobile browsers takes precedence over styling consistency.

## Examples

### Basic date picker

Render `DatePicker` with an accessible label or `aria-label`. Use `value` and `onValueChange` for controlled state.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { DatePicker, Label } from '@innostes/ui';

export function InvoiceDueDate() {
  const [dueDate, setDueDate] = useState<Date | null>(new Date());

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Label htmlFor="invoice-due">Payment due date</Label>
      <DatePicker
        id="invoice-due"
        name="dueDate"
        value={dueDate}
        onValueChange={setDueDate}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Date formatting and locale

The trigger formats dates using `Intl.DateTimeFormat` with `dateStyle: 'medium'` by default. You can supply custom `Intl.DateTimeFormatOptions` or a custom formatting function via the `format` prop. Pass `locale` to ensure month and day names correspond to the user's regional dialect.

```tsx
import { DatePicker } from '@innostes/ui';

export function FormattedDatePicker() {
  return (
    <DatePicker
      locale="en-IN"
      format={{ day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' }}
      aria-label="Voucher date"
    />
  );
}
```

### Date constraints and disabled days

Bound selectable dates using `min` and `max`. Use `isDateDisabled` to disable specific dates such as regional holidays or non-working days.

```tsx
import { DatePicker } from '@innostes/ui';

const isSunday = (date: Date) => date.getDay() === 0;

export function DeliverySlotPicker() {
  return (
    <DatePicker
      min={new Date()}
      isDateDisabled={isSunday}
      placeholder="Select working day"
      aria-label="Delivery slot"
    />
  );
}
```

### Month and year dropdown navigation

Set `captionLayout="dropdown"` to display dropdown selectors for year and month inside the popover calendar. This is ideal for historical dates such as employee date of birth or company incorporation.

```tsx
import { DatePicker } from '@innostes/ui';

export function DateOfBirthPicker() {
  return (
    <DatePicker
      captionLayout="dropdown"
      fromYear={1950}
      toYear={2010}
      placeholder="Select date of birth"
      aria-label="Date of birth"
    />
  );
}
```

### Date range picker with presets

`DateRangePicker` renders a popover with dual-month navigation alongside quick preset selections (e.g., "Today", "Last 7 days", "Last 30 days", "This month"). The `onValueChange` callback triggers when both `from` and `to` dates are chosen, or immediately when a preset button is clicked.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { DateRangePicker, type DateRange } from '@innostes/ui';

export function TaxPeriodFilter() {
  const [period, setPeriod] = useState<DateRange>({
    from: new Date(2026, 3, 1),
    to: new Date(2026, 3, 30),
  });

  return (
    <DateRangePicker
      value={period}
      onValueChange={setPeriod}
      startName="startDate"
      endName="endDate"
      aria-label="GST tax period"
    />
  );
}
```

You can define custom presets or pass an empty array (`presets={[]}`) to remove the preset column:

```tsx
import { DateRangePicker, defaultDateRangePresets } from '@innostes/ui';

const fiscalPresets = [
  {
    label: 'Q1 (Apr–Jun)',
    range: () => ({ from: new Date(2026, 3, 1), to: new Date(2026, 5, 30) }),
  },
  ...defaultDateRangePresets,
];

export function CustomPresetsDemo() {
  return <DateRangePicker presets={fiscalPresets} aria-label="Fiscal period" />;
}
```

### Form integration and submission

`DatePicker` renders a hidden `<input type="hidden">` with the chosen date formatted as `YYYY-MM-DD` under the given `name` prop. `DateRangePicker` accepts `startName` and `endName` to submit both dates in standard HTML forms and server actions.

```tsx
import { DatePicker, Field, FieldLabel, FieldError } from '@innostes/ui';

export function FormDatePickerExample() {
  return (
    <form action="/api/v1/invoices" method="POST">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel htmlFor="due-date">Invoice due date</FieldLabel>
        <DatePicker id="due-date" name="dueDate" required />
        <FieldError />
      </Field>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

`DatePicker` and `DateRangePicker` follow WAI-ARIA combobox and popover dialog specifications.

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  entries={[
    { key: 'Enter / Space', action: 'Opens the calendar popover when focused on the trigger button.' },
    { key: 'Down Arrow', action: 'Opens the calendar popover and shifts keyboard focus to the calendar grid.' },
    { key: 'Escape', action: 'Closes the popover calendar and restores focus to the trigger button.' },
    { key: 'Tab', action: 'Navigates focus within the popover between the calendar grid, presets, and month controls.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers

- The trigger element is an accessible button rendered with `aria-haspopup="dialog"`.
- When opened, focus moves into the calendar grid, which announces the currently focused day with day of week, day number, month, and year.
- Selected dates are announced with `aria-selected="true"`.
- The clear button includes a localized `aria-label` ("Clear date" by default).

## Guidelines

<DoDont
  do={{
    description: 'Provide an explicit label using FieldLabel or an aria-label attribute so screen reader users understand what date is requested.',
    code: `<Label htmlFor="dispatch">Dispatch date</Label>\n<DatePicker id="dispatch" name="dispatchDate" />`,
  }}
  dont={{
    description: 'Do not rely solely on placeholder text as a field label; placeholders vanish once a date is picked.',
    code: `<DatePicker placeholder="Dispatch date" />`,
  }}
/>

<DoDont
  do={{
    description: 'Specify startName and endName on DateRangePicker so HTML form submissions submit cleanly separated ISO dates without extra parsing.',
    code: `<DateRangePicker startName="startDate" endName="endDate" />`,
  }}
  dont={{
    description: 'Do not parse a composite string manually on the server when separate hidden inputs are already provided.',
    code: `// Avoid manual string splitting of "01/04/2026 - 30/04/2026"`,
  }}
/>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['DatePicker', 'DateRangePicker']} baseUi="popover" />

## Related

- [Calendar](/ui/docs/components/forms/calendar) — Inline calendar month grid for dashboards and date visualization.
- [Field](/ui/docs/components/forms/field) — Form field container with label, description, and error messaging.
- [Input](/ui/docs/components/forms/input) — Standard text, numeric, and native date inputs.

## Field and Form (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/field)

Accessible form container linking labels, descriptions, and errors with native constraint validation and server error mapping.

`Field` and `Form` provide the foundational scaffolding for all enterprise forms in `@innostes/ui`. Built on Base UI's field primitive, `Field` automatically links labels to controls via `htmlFor`, connects descriptive notes and error messages via `aria-describedby`, and manages `aria-invalid` without manual ID wiring.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/field/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import {
  Field,
  FieldLabel,
  FieldDescription,
  FieldError,
  FieldItem,
  Fieldset,
  FieldsetLegend,
  Form,
  FormActions,
  FormGrid,
  FormSection,
} from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use Field** around any input, select, textarea, or checkbox to automatically manage accessible names, helper text, and validation feedback.
- **Use Form** to coordinate form submission, capture values as keyed objects, map server validation errors, and focus the first invalid control automatically.
- **Use FormGrid and FormSection** to arrange complex ERP forms into structured, responsive multi-column layouts.

## Examples

### Purchase order header

A realistic ERP purchase order header combining `Form`, `FormGrid`, `Field`, `Select`, `Input`, and `FormActions`:

<ComponentPreview name="forms/field/purchase-order-header" />

### Native constraint validation

`Field` integrates with standard browser HTML5 constraint validation attributes (`required`, `minLength`, `pattern`, `min`, `max`):

```tsx
<Field name="email">
  <FieldLabel required>Work email</FieldLabel>
  <Input type="email" required />
  <FieldError match="valueMissing">Email address is required.</FieldError>
  <FieldError match="typeMismatch">Enter a valid email address.</FieldError>
</Field>
```

### Custom and asynchronous validation

Supply a custom validator function via the `validate` prop on `Field`. The function receives the control value and returns an error message string or `null`:

```tsx
<Field
  name="poNumber"
  validate={async (value) => {
    if (!value) return 'PO number is required';
    const exists = await checkPoExistsOnServer(String(value));
    return exists ? 'This purchase order number already exists.' : null;
  }}
>
  <FieldLabel required>PO number</FieldLabel>
  <Input placeholder="PO-2026-0000" />
  <FieldError match="customError" />
</Field>
```

### Server errors mapped to fields

When a backend API rejects a submission, pass the returned error record to `Form`'s `errors` prop. Each error maps automatically to the matching `<FieldError>` child:

<ComponentPreview name="forms/field/form" />

### Validation timing and focus management

By default, validation runs when the form is submitted (`validationMode="onSubmit"`). You can configure `validationMode` on individual fields or across the entire `Form`:

- `onSubmit`: Validates only upon form submission (avoids premature nagging).
- `onBlur`: Validates when the user tabs out of the input.
- `onChange`: Re-validates immediately on keystroke once the field is dirty.

When a submission fails validation, `Form` automatically moves keyboard focus to the **first invalid field** in DOM order, allowing keyboard and screen-reader users to remediate mistakes immediately.

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'Tab', action: 'Moves focus sequentially across interactive controls inside the form.' },
    { key: 'Enter', action: 'Submits the form when focused inside a single-line input field.' },
    { key: 'Escape', action: 'Dismisses active select dropdowns or combobox popups without closing the form.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **Automatic `aria-describedby`**: `Field` computes unique internal IDs and sets `aria-describedby` pointing to both `<FieldDescription>` and `<FieldError>`.
- **`aria-invalid`**: Automatically set to `true` on the enclosed input whenever validation fails.
- **Live region error announcements**: `<FieldError>` emits errors in an ARIA live region so screen readers announce corrections without requiring navigation away from the current field.

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Always wrap interactive form inputs inside a `<Field>` with a visible `<FieldLabel>` for sustained accessibility.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never rely on input `placeholder` text as a substitute for a visible `<FieldLabel>`.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Write specific, constructive error messages explaining how to resolve the issue (e.g. "Enter an 8-character GSTIN number").
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never emit vague errors such as "Invalid input" or "Field error".
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable
  components={[
    'Field',
    'FieldLabel',
    'FieldDescription',
    'FieldError',
    'FieldItem',
    'Fieldset',
    'FieldsetLegend',
    'Form',
    'FormActions',
    'FormGrid',
    'FormSection',
  ]}
  baseUi="field"
/>

## File Dropzone (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/file-dropzone)

MIME type and extension checking, file size and count constraints, image thumbnails, and native form integration.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/file-dropzone/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import {
  FileDropzone,
  formatBytes,
  type FileDropzoneProps,
  type FileRejection,
} from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

Use `FileDropzone` when users need to attach documents, images, spreadsheets, or archives to records:

- Attaching purchase order receipts, vendor contracts, or shipping manifests.
- Uploading batch CSV or XLSX files for bulk inventory or price list imports.
- Adding company logos, user avatars, or product catalogue photography.

When choosing between file input patterns:
- Use `FileDropzone` when users benefit from a prominent drag target, thumbnail previews, and instant client-side file rejection messages.
- Use a standard [Button](/ui/docs/components/actions/button) wrapping a visually hidden native `<input type="file">` if screen real estate is constrained to a single compact row.

## Examples

### Basic upload zone

Provide `name`, `accept`, `maxSize`, and a helpful `hint` describing allowed extensions and file sizes.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FileDropzone } from '@innostes/ui';

export function ReceiptAttachment() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);

  return (
    <FileDropzone
      name="receipts"
      accept="image/*,.pdf"
      maxSize={5_000_000}
      maxFiles={3}
      hint="PDF or images, up to 5 MB each"
      value={files}
      onValueChange={setFiles}
    />
  );
}
```

### File constraints and validation

`FileDropzone` validates dropped or selected files against `accept`, `maxSize`, and `maxFiles`. Invalid files trigger `onReject` with an array of `FileRejection` objects explaining why each file was disallowed (`type`, `size`, or `count`).

```tsx
'use client';

import { FileDropzone, type FileRejection } from '@innostes/ui';

export function StrictDropzone() {
  const handleReject = (rejections: FileRejection[]) => {
    rejections.forEach(({ file, reasons }) => {
      console.warn(`Rejected ${file.name}: ${reasons.join(', ')}`);
    });
  };

  return (
    <FileDropzone
      accept=".csv,.xlsx"
      maxSize={2_000_000}
      maxFiles={1}
      multiple={false}
      hint="Single CSV or XLSX file up to 2 MB"
      onReject={handleReject}
    />
  );
}
```

### Custom file list with upload progress

Set `showFileList={false}` to hide the built-in static list and render a custom file queue with live progress bars (e.g. while uploading chunks to Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage).

<ComponentPreview name="forms/file-dropzone/upload-progress" />

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { FileDropzone, Progress, formatBytes } from '@innostes/ui';

export function UploadWithProgress() {
  const [files, setFiles] = useState<File[]>([]);
  const [uploadProgress, setUploadProgress] = useState(65);

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-4">
      <FileDropzone
        name="contract"
        accept=".pdf"
        showFileList={false}
        onValueChange={setFiles}
        hint="PDF documents up to 10 MB"
      />
      {files.map((file) => (
        <div key={file.name} className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 rounded-lg border p-3">
          <div className="flex justify-between text-sm">
            <span>{file.name}</span>
            <span>{formatBytes(file.size)}</span>
          </div>
          <Progress value={uploadProgress} aria-label={`Uploading ${file.name}`} />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Form integration and submission

`FileDropzone` syncs its internal file list to a real, hidden `<input type="file" name="...">` element. This allows standard `multipart/form-data` form submissions and Next.js server actions to read uploaded files directly without manual FormData wiring.

```tsx
import { FileDropzone, Field, FieldLabel } from '@innostes/ui';

export function VendorVerificationForm() {
  return (
    <form action="/api/v1/vendors/verify" method="POST" encType="multipart/form-data">
      <Field>
        <FieldLabel htmlFor="gst-cert">GST registration certificate</FieldLabel>
        <FileDropzone
          id="gst-cert"
          name="certificate"
          accept=".pdf"
          maxFiles={1}
          required
        />
      </Field>
    </form>
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

`FileDropzone` complies with WCAG 2.2 AA non-text contrast, keyboard access, and assistive technology requirements.

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  entries={[
    { key: 'Tab', action: 'Moves focus to the "Browse files" button inside the zone or removal buttons in the list.' },
    { key: 'Enter / Space', action: 'Activates the focused "Browse files" trigger, opening the native operating system file picker.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers

- The file input and browse action are exposed via an accessible `<button>` connected to the hidden file input. Users never need drag-and-drop gestures to upload files.
- The `hint` text is linked to the browse trigger via `aria-describedby`.
- When files are rejected due to invalid extensions, exceeding byte counts, or count limits, error notifications are injected inside an ARIA live region (`role="alert"`).
- Remove buttons in the file list provide explicit accessible labels including the file name (e.g., `Remove invoice-001.pdf`).

## Guidelines

<DoDont
  do={{
    description: 'Always validate file MIME types, byte sizes, and magic numbers on the backend server before storage.',
    code: `// Express / Fastify / FastAPI server check\nif (file.size > 5_000_000) raise_error();`,
  }}
  dont={{
    description: 'Never trust client-side accept filters as a security boundary against malicious executables or payloads.',
    code: `// INSECURE: Assuming accept=".pdf" prevents malicious file execution\nconst saveToDisk = (file) => fs.writeFileSync(file.name, file.buffer);`,
  }}
/>

<DoDont
  do={{
    description: 'Always display explicit file size and format limits in the hint so users know constraints beforehand.',
    code: `<FileDropzone hint="PDF or PNG up to 10 MB each, maximum 3 files" />`,
  }}
  dont={{
    description: 'Do not hide size and type constraints until after the user attempts a failed upload.',
    code: `<FileDropzone /> // Missing guidance`,
  }}
/>

## Forms (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/index)

Input fields, pickers, validation containers, and specialised editors for complex data entry.

import { CategoryGrid } from '@/components/docs/category-grid';

# Forms

Enterprise applications rely heavily on accurate, structured data entry. innostes UI form components wrap Base UI primitives with consistent OKLCH styling, validation feedback, accessible labelling via `Field`, and localized formatting for dates, currencies, and numbers.

## Components

<CategoryGrid category="components/forms" />

## Form design principles

- **Always label inputs**: Wrap form controls with `<Field>` or provide explicit `aria-label`s for screen reader announcements.
- **Validation feedback**: Display errors inline beneath the offending input using `<FieldError>`, and mark inputs with `invalid` to set appropriate ARIA attributes.
- **Progressive enhancement**: Specialised controls like `DatePicker` and `LocaleSelect` fallback cleanly to standard inputs when necessary.

---

## Input Group (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/input-group)

Unified input container merging leading and trailing addons, copy triggers, and currency labels.

`InputGroup` merges single-line inputs with leading and trailing addons into a single contiguous bordered track. It is designed for URL prefixes, monetary currency denominations (e.g. `₹` and `INR`), unit indicators (e.g. `kg`, `litres`), and inline copy buttons.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/input-group/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import {
  InputGroup,
  InputGroupInput,
  InputGroupAddon,
  SearchInput,
  PasswordInput,
} from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use InputGroup** when an input requires an explicit unit of measurement, protocol prefix (`https://`), currency symbol, or action button directly attached to the input boundary.
- **Use Input** for plain text fields that do not require affixed addons.
- **Use NumberField** when capturing numbers that require stepper up/down buttons and automatic locale formatting.

## Examples

### Currency and unit addons

Add static currency glyphs and unit labels:

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Procurement unit price</FieldLabel>
  <InputGroup>
    <InputGroupAddon>₹</InputGroupAddon>
    <InputGroupInput inputMode="decimal" placeholder="0.00" />
    <InputGroupAddon>INR</InputGroupAddon>
  </InputGroup>
</Field>
```

### URL protocol prefix

Affix domain and protocol prefixes:

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Tenant portal address</FieldLabel>
  <InputGroup>
    <InputGroupAddon>https://</InputGroupAddon>
    <InputGroupInput placeholder="northwind" />
    <InputGroupAddon>.innostes.com</InputGroupAddon>
  </InputGroup>
</Field>
```

### Icon addon with inline action button

Combine an icon prefix with a trailing copy trigger button:

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>ERP webhook key</FieldLabel>
  <InputGroup>
    <InputGroupAddon variant="icon">
      <Key className="size-4 text-muted-foreground" />
    </InputGroupAddon>
    <InputGroupInput defaultValue="whsec_908234892019" readOnly font-mono />
    <InputGroupAddon variant="icon" className="pe-1">
      <Button
        size="sm"
        variant="ghost"
        iconOnly
        aria-label="Copy webhook secret"
        onClick={() => navigator.clipboard.writeText('whsec_908234892019')}
      >
        <Copy className="size-3.5" />
      </Button>
    </InputGroupAddon>
  </InputGroup>
</Field>
```

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'Tab', action: 'Focuses the inner input field, or moves to the interactive addon button if present.' },
    { key: 'Space / Enter', action: 'Triggers action buttons housed within the addon slots.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **Focus containment**: Clicking on a static text or icon addon transfers focus automatically to the nested input element.
- **Semantic grouping**: The container groups visual addons without fragmenting the accessibility tree, preserving standard `aria-describedby` associations from `<Field>`.

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Use `InputGroupAddon` for short units (e.g. `₹`, `kg`, `cm`, `https://`) that provide immediate formatting context.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never place lengthy prose or instructional sentences inside an addon slot; use `<FieldDescription>` instead.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Always supply an explicit `aria-label` when placing an icon-only button inside an addon slot.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never attach multiple overlapping action buttons to a single input track; limit addons to one clear secondary trigger.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## Input (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/input)

Accessible single-line input field supporting multiple types, clear buttons, password visibility toggles, and automatic Field wiring.

import { InputPlayground } from '@/components/docs/input-playground';

`Input` is the primary single-line text entry primitive in `@innostes/ui`. Built on Base UI's input primitive, it automatically coordinates validation states (`aria-invalid`), disabled styling, focus rings, and font metrics across three standardized enterprise size scales.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/input/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import { Input, SearchInput, PasswordInput, inputVariants } from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use Input** for brief, single-line textual data such as names, email addresses, phone numbers, codes, or URL slugs.
- **Use Textarea** when users need to enter multiline sentences, remarks, or notes.
- **Use NumberField** when capturing numeric data that requires stepping, bounds checking, or currency formatting.
- **Use InputGroup** when prepending or appending icons, currency symbols, or action buttons directly to the field track.

## Examples

### Interactive playground

Customize sizes, HTML types, and validation states in real time:

<InputPlayground />

### Sizes

Inputs support three standardized heights aligning with buttons and selects:

```tsx
<Input size="sm" placeholder="Compact input (32px)" />
<Input size="md" placeholder="Default input (40px)" />
<Input size="lg" placeholder="Comfortable input (48px)" />
```

### Search input

`SearchInput` provides an integrated search glyph, clear button, and accessible keyboard shortcut styling:

```tsx
<SearchInput
  placeholder="Search purchase orders or vendor codes..."
  onClear={() => console.log('Search cleared')}
/>
```

### Password input

`PasswordInput` includes an accessible password visibility toggle button with eye icons:

```tsx
<PasswordInput placeholder="Enter ERP account password" />
```

### File upload input

Inputs with `type="file"` inherit proper custom file-picker button styling:

```tsx
<Input type="file" aria-label="Upload supplier invoice PDF" />
```

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'Tab', action: 'Moves focus into the text field or moves forward to the next form element.' },
    { key: 'Shift + Tab', action: 'Moves focus back to the preceding form control.' },
    { key: 'Escape', action: 'Clears search text when focused inside a SearchInput.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **Accessible naming**: An input must always be associated with a label using `<FieldLabel>`, a native `<label htmlFor="...">`, or an explicit `aria-label`.
- **Validation state**: When wrapped inside `<Field>`, `aria-invalid="true"` is automatically populated upon validation failure, triggering red border rings and auditory error feedback.

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Use placeholder text only for formatting examples (e.g. `PO-2026-0001`), never as a replacement for a visible label.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never rely on placeholder text to convey instructions, because placeholders disappear once the user begins typing.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Set appropriate `type`, `inputMode`, and `autoComplete` attributes (such as `type="email"` or `inputMode="numeric"`).
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never disable autocomplete on standard login or address fields unless required by strict security policies.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['Input', 'SearchInput', 'PasswordInput']} baseUi="input" />

- [Field and Form](/ui/docs/components/forms/field) — Accessible form container managing labels, descriptions, and errors.
- [InputGroup](/ui/docs/components/forms/input-group) — Prepend and append icons or currency symbols to input fields.
- [NumberField](/ui/docs/components/forms/number-field) — Specialized numerical input with step increment buttons.

## Locale Selects (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/locale-select)

Pre-configured searchable select components returning standard ISO and IANA codes with zero third-party dataset bundle overhead.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/locale-select/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import {
  CountrySelect,
  TimezoneSelect,
  LanguageSelect,
  CurrencySelect,
  DateFormatSelect,
  type CountrySelectProps,
  type TimezoneSelectProps,
  type LanguageSelectProps,
  type CurrencySelectProps,
  type DateFormatSelectProps,
} from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

Use the locale select family when capturing regional and internationalisation configuration on settings pages, customer onboarding screens, or vendor registries:

- **CountrySelect**: Assigning registered business addresses, shipping destinations, or tax jurisdictions using ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (e.g. `"IN"`, `"DE"`, `"US"`).
- **TimezoneSelect**: Configuring tenant business hours, shift rosters, or automated invoice generation schedules using IANA time zone identifiers (e.g. `"Asia/Kolkata"`).
- **LanguageSelect**: Setting user interface preferences or customer notification templates using BCP 47 language tags (e.g. `"en-IN"`, `"hi"`).
- **CurrencySelect**: Defining multi-currency pricing, base accounting ledgers, or payment gateway currencies using ISO 4217 codes (e.g. `"INR"`, `"USD"`).
- **DateFormatSelect**: Letting users configure their preferred display format for calendar and invoice dates (e.g. `"DD/MM/YYYY"`).

When choosing between locale components and general selects:
- Use `LocaleSelect` components when selecting from standard international registries—names automatically localise to the user's browser runtime through `Intl.DisplayNames` without downloading megabytes of static JSON files.
- Use [SearchableSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select) or [Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox) when presenting domain-specific datasets (such as warehouse bins, internal cost centres, or custom product groups).

## Examples

### Country selection

`CountrySelect` provides searchable country names accompanied by flag indicators. You can specify `priority` to pin operational jurisdictions to the top of the list.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { CountrySelect, Label } from '@innostes/ui';

export function CompanyRegistrationCountry() {
  const [country, setCountry] = useState('IN');

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Label htmlFor="registered-country">Country of incorporation</Label>
      <CountrySelect
        id="registered-country"
        name="countryCode"
        value={country}
        onValueChange={setCountry}
        priority={['IN', 'AE', 'SG', 'GB', 'US']}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Time zone selection

`TimezoneSelect` lists IANA time zone names sorted by UTC offset, formatting each item with its current offset (e.g., `(GMT+05:30) Asia/Kolkata`). Search matches both city names and GMT offset numerals.

```tsx
import { TimezoneSelect, Label } from '@innostes/ui';

export function WarehouseTimezone() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Label htmlFor="warehouse-tz">Operating time zone</Label>
      <TimezoneSelect
        id="warehouse-tz"
        name="timeZone"
        defaultValue="Asia/Kolkata"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Language selection

`LanguageSelect` displays language names in both the active user's language and the native autonym (e.g. "German · Deutsch").

```tsx
import { LanguageSelect, Label } from '@innostes/ui';

export function DocumentLanguage() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Label htmlFor="doc-lang">Invoice template language</Label>
      <LanguageSelect
        id="doc-lang"
        name="language"
        defaultValue="en-IN"
        priority={['en-IN', 'hi', 'ta', 'te']}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Currency selection

`CurrencySelect` resolves ISO 4217 currency names and symbols through `Intl.DisplayNames`.

```tsx
import { CurrencySelect, Label } from '@innostes/ui';

export function LedgerCurrency() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Label htmlFor="ledger-curr">Functional currency</Label>
      <CurrencySelect
        id="ledger-curr"
        name="currency"
        defaultValue="INR"
        priority={['INR', 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP', 'AED']}
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Date format selection

`DateFormatSelect` presents common regional date patterns (e.g. `DD/MM/YYYY`, `MM/DD/YYYY`, `YYYY-MM-DD`).

```tsx
import { DateFormatSelect, Label } from '@innostes/ui';

export function DisplayDateFormat() {
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col gap-2">
      <Label htmlFor="date-fmt">Preferred date format</Label>
      <DateFormatSelect
        id="date-fmt"
        name="dateFormat"
        defaultValue="DD/MM/YYYY"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Prioritised options and inclusion filters

Use `include` to restrict options to an approved whitelist (e.g. only countries where your logistics network operates), and `priority` to pin preferred items to the top of the dropdown menu:

```tsx
import { CountrySelect } from '@innostes/ui';

export function ShippingJurisdictions() {
  return (
    <CountrySelect
      include={['IN', 'AE', 'SG', 'MY']}
      priority={['IN']}
      placeholder="Select shipping destination"
      aria-label="Shipping country"
    />
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

All locale pickers are built on top of [SearchableSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select) and Base UI Combobox/Select primitives.

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  entries={[
    { key: 'Down Arrow / Up Arrow', action: 'Navigates through the list of countries, currencies, time zones, or languages.' },
    { key: 'Enter', action: 'Selects the currently focused locale option and closes the popover.' },
    { key: 'Escape', action: 'Closes the popup menu and returns focus to the search input.' },
    { key: 'Character keys', action: 'Filters options dynamically in real time.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers

- Triggers announce their expanded/collapsed state via `aria-expanded`.
- Search inputs carry `role="combobox"` with `aria-autocomplete="list"`.
- Options are marked with `role="option"` and `aria-selected` indicates current selection.
- List filtering announces matched option counts to assistive technology.

## Guidelines

<DoDont
  do={{
    description: 'Use the priority prop to place the home country and major trading partners at the top of long lists.',
    code: `<CountrySelect priority={['IN', 'AE', 'US']} />`,
  }}
  dont={{
    description: 'Do not force users to scroll through 200+ alphabetically ordered countries to select their domestic region.',
    code: `<CountrySelect /> // Without priority in a localized Indian ERP context`,
  }}
/>

<DoDont
  do={{
    description: 'Store standard ISO/IANA codes in your database (e.g., "Asia/Kolkata", "INR", "IN").',
    code: `const payload = { currency: 'INR', country: 'IN' };`,
  }}
  dont={{
    description: 'Do not store localized display names like "Indian Rupee" or "India" in transaction tables.',
    code: `// Flaky and difficult to query across localized tenants\nconst payload = { currency: 'Indian Rupee' };`,
  }}
/>

## API reference

<ApiTable
  components={[
    'CountrySelect',
    'TimezoneSelect',
    'LanguageSelect',
    'CurrencySelect',
    'DateFormatSelect',
  ]}
  baseUi="combobox"
/>

## Related

- [SearchableSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select) — Generic searchable single-select component.
- [Select](/ui/docs/components/forms/select) — Standard select dropdown for concise lists.
- [Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox) — Typeahead combobox with autocomplete.

## Number Field (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/number-field)

Accessible numeric input field supporting min/max bounds, wheel stepping, and en-IN currency and percent formats.

`NumberField` provides a precision numerical input control. Built on Base UI's number field primitive, it manages numeric stepping, bounds clamping (`min`, `max`), keyboard increment shortcuts, and automatic `Intl.NumberFormat` localization for Indian Rupees (`INR`), percentages, and quantities.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/number-field/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import { NumberField } from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use NumberField** when capturing quantitative figures that benefit from stepping, bounds clamping, or locale-aware currency formatting (e.g. order quantities, prices, discount rates).
- **Use Input** with `type="number"` only for simple unbounded numbers without stepping or formatting needs.
- **Use Slider** when visual spatial selection along a continuous track is preferred over typed numeric input.

## Examples

### Currency formatting in en-IN

`NumberField` formats numbers according to Indian numbering grouping rules (thousands, lakhs, crores) when supplied with `locale="en-IN"`:

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Procurement invoice total</FieldLabel>
  <NumberField
    defaultValue={145280.50}
    step={100}
    locale="en-IN"
    format={{ style: 'currency', currency: 'INR' }}
  />
  <FieldDescription>Displays as ₹1,45,280.50 with proper Indian digit grouping.</FieldDescription>
</Field>
```

### Percentage calculation

When formatting percentages, supply a decimal fraction (e.g. `0.18` for 18%):

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>GST tax slab</FieldLabel>
  <NumberField
    defaultValue={0.18}
    min={0}
    max={0.28}
    step={0.01}
    locale="en-IN"
    format={{ style: 'percent' }}
  />
</Field>
```

### Bounds and step behavior

Enforce minimum, maximum, and step increments:

```tsx
<NumberField
  defaultValue={10}
  min={1}
  max={100}
  step={5}
  largeStep={25}
  aria-label="Pallet batch quantity"
/>
```

- **`step`**: Determines the increment for Up/Down arrow keys and stepper buttons (defaults to `1`).
- **`largeStep`**: Determines the increment for `PageUp` and `PageDown` keys (defaults to `10`).
- **Clamping**: Typing a number outside `[min, max]` automatically clamps to the boundary when the field loses focus.

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'ArrowUp', action: 'Increments the current value by one step.' },
    { key: 'ArrowDown', action: 'Decrements the current value by one step.' },
    { key: 'PageUp', action: 'Increments the current value by largeStep.' },
    { key: 'PageDown', action: 'Decrements the current value by largeStep.' },
    { key: 'Home', action: 'Jumps directly to the min bound value if defined.' },
    { key: 'End', action: 'Jumps directly to the max bound value if defined.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **`role="spinbutton"`**: Identifies the control as an accessible numeric spinner.
- **ARIA attributes**: Automatically exposes `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, `aria-valuemax`, and `aria-valuetext` (reflecting localized formatted currency or percentages).

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Specify `locale="en-IN"` and `currency="INR"` for Indian enterprise ERP applications to guarantee correct rupee symbols and lakh/crore commas.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never hardcode currency symbols into input value strings manually; let `NumberField`'s `format` prop handle internationalisation.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Set sensible `min` bounds (such as `min={0}` or `min={1}`) to prevent invalid negative quantities on purchase orders.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never leave numeric bounds open when negative values would break downstream accounting workflows.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['NumberField']} baseUi="number-field" />

## Related

- [Slider](/ui/docs/components/forms/slider) — Interactive sliding track selector for numeric ranges.
- [InputGroup](/ui/docs/components/forms/input-group) — Affix currency symbols or units to standard text fields.
- [Field and Form](/ui/docs/components/forms/field) — Accessible form validation container.

---

## Radio Group (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/radio-group)

Accessible radio group primitive for selecting exactly one option from a visible set of choices.

`RadioGroup` allows operators to select exactly one option from a set of mutually exclusive choices. Built on Base UI's radio primitive, it manages roving tabindex across options, coordinates native arrow-key navigation, and automatically exposes checked state attributes (`has-data-checked`) for custom card-style radio controls.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/radio-group/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import { Radio, RadioGroup } from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use RadioGroup** when users must select exactly one option from a visible list of 2 to 5 options.
- **Use Select** when screen real estate is limited or the list contains 5 to 15 options.
- **Use Checkbox** when users can select multiple options independently or toggle a single agreement.

### Selection control comparison

| Control | Selection count | Number of options | Search filter | Best suited for |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **RadioGroup** | Single | 2 to 5 | No | Visible choices where side-by-side comparison is essential (e.g. shipping tier) |
| **[Select](/ui/docs/components/forms/select)** | Single | 5 to 15 | No | Compact dropdown selection with a predefined list (e.g. payment terms) |
| **[SearchableSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select)** | Single | 15 to 100+ | Yes | Long lists requiring keyboard search filtering (e.g. warehouse depot) |
| **[Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox)** | Single or Multi | 50 to 10,000+ | Yes | Large async remote datasets or autocomplete with custom item creation |
| **[TagInput](/ui/docs/components/forms/tag-input)** | Multi | Variable | Yes | Categorical metadata, SKU keywords, and multi-tag filtering |

## Examples

### Card-style radio options

Style entire card containers using CSS `has-data-checked:` variants:

```tsx
<RadioGroup defaultValue="express" aria-label="Carrier shipping tier">
  <label className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border p-3 cursor-pointer has-data-checked:border-primary has-data-checked:bg-primary/5">
    <Radio value="standard" className="mt-0.5" />
    <div>
      <span className="text-sm font-medium">Standard Road Transport</span>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">3-5 business days via Blue Dart</p>
    </div>
  </label>
  <label className="flex items-start gap-3 rounded-lg border border-border p-3 cursor-pointer has-data-checked:border-primary has-data-checked:bg-primary/5">
    <Radio value="express" className="mt-0.5" />
    <div>
      <span className="text-sm font-medium">Express Air Cargo</span>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">Next-day arrival at Bengaluru Airport</p>
    </div>
  </label>
</RadioGroup>
```

### Form integration with field

Coordinate radio groups inside `<Field>`:

```tsx
<Field name="settlementType">
  <FieldLabel required>Settlement method</FieldLabel>
  <RadioGroup defaultValue="neft">
    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Radio value="neft" /> NEFT / RTGS</label>
    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Radio value="upi" /> Corporate UPI</label>
    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm"><Radio value="letter-of-credit" /> Letter of credit</label>
  </RadioGroup>
  <FieldError />
</Field>
```

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'ArrowDown / ArrowRight', action: 'Moves selection and focus to the next radio option, wrapping to the first.' },
    { key: 'ArrowUp / ArrowLeft', action: 'Moves selection and focus to the previous radio option, wrapping to the last.' },
    { key: 'Space', action: 'Selects the currently focused radio button if not already selected.' },
    { key: 'Tab', action: 'Enters or exits the radio group as a single combined tab stop.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **`role="radiogroup"`**: Automatically applied to the wrapper container.
- **Roving focus**: Only the selected radio button has `tabIndex={0}`, allowing the user to tab directly past the entire group once an option is set.
- **`aria-checked`**: Screen readers announce "checked" or "not checked" automatically as arrow keys cycle options.

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Provide a default selected value whenever possible so the form state is always deterministic.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never use `RadioGroup` for multi-item selection; use `Checkbox` or `CheckboxGroup` instead.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Limit radio groups to 5 or fewer options to preserve vertical screen space in complex ERP layouts.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never present 10+ options in a radio group; use `Select` or `SearchableSelect` instead.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['RadioGroup', 'Radio']} baseUi="radio" />

## Related

- [Select](/ui/docs/components/forms/select) — Dropdown menu selection for medium option lists.
- [Checkbox](/ui/docs/components/forms/checkbox) — Independent multi-item selection.
- [ToggleGroup](/ui/docs/components/actions/toggle-group) — Connected segmented buttons for view toggling.

## Rich Text Editor (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/rich-text-editor)

Bold, headings, lists, quotes, links, and history shortcuts packaged in a modular entry point with form validation support.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/rich-text-editor/basic" />

The editor lives in a **separate entry point** (`@innostes/ui/editor`) so applications that do not require rich text editing do not bundle Tiptap dependencies.

## Import

```tsx
import {
  RichTextEditor,
  type RichTextEditorProps,
  type RichTextEditorLabels,
  type RichTextTool,
} from '@innostes/ui/editor';
```

## When to use

Use `RichTextEditor` when users need to author formatted prose beyond the limits of a plain text area:

- Adding warehouse delivery instructions, packing specifications, or special handling notes on purchase orders.
- Editing product catalogue marketing descriptions with bolding, lists, and external reference links.
- Authoring internal standard operating procedures (SOPs) or supplier terms and conditions.

When choosing between text inputs:
- Use [Textarea](/ui/docs/components/forms/textarea) for plain, unformatted multiline input (e.g. shipping street address, feedback comments, or remarks).
- Use `RichTextEditor` when users require formatted structure such as bulleted lists, headings, and inline links.

## Examples

### Installation

`RichTextEditor` is built on [Tiptap](https://tiptap.dev) 3. Install its peer dependencies in your application:

```bash
pnpm add @tiptap/react @tiptap/pm @tiptap/core @tiptap/starter-kit @tiptap/extensions
```

### Basic editor

Provide `value` and `onValueChange` for controlled operation. An empty editor normalises to an empty string `""`, making standard form validation checks straightforward.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldLabel } from '@innostes/ui';
import { RichTextEditor } from '@innostes/ui/editor';

export function PurchaseOrderNotes() {
  const [content, setContent] = useState('');

  return (
    <Field>
      <FieldLabel id="po-notes">Delivery and unloading notes</FieldLabel>
      <RichTextEditor
        aria-labelledby="po-notes"
        placeholder="Specify delivery bay, contact numbers, and unloading hours…"
        value={content}
        onValueChange={setContent}
      />
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Form validation and error state

Pass `invalid={true}` (or integrate inside `Field` with validation errors) to apply the semantic destructive border and ring tokens, setting `data-invalid` and `aria-invalid`.

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Field, FieldLabel, FieldError } from '@innostes/ui';
import { RichTextEditor } from '@innostes/ui/editor';

export function ValidatedEditor() {
  const [html, setHtml] = useState('');
  const [hasSubmitted, setHasSubmitted] = useState(false);
  const isInvalid = hasSubmitted && html.trim().length === 0;

  return (
    <Field invalid={isInvalid}>
      <FieldLabel id="scope-label">Work scope description</FieldLabel>
      <RichTextEditor
        aria-labelledby="scope-label"
        value={html}
        onValueChange={setHtml}
        invalid={isInvalid}
      />
      {isInvalid && <FieldError>Work scope description is required.</FieldError>}
    </Field>
  );
}
```

### Custom toolbar configuration

Customise the visible toolbar actions using the `toolbar` prop, or pass `false` to hide the visual toolbar while preserving keyboard and Markdown shortcuts. Use `'|'` to insert visual dividers between action groups.

```tsx
import { RichTextEditor } from '@innostes/ui/editor';

export function MinimalEditor() {
  return (
    <RichTextEditor
      toolbar={['bold', 'italic', '|', 'bulletList', 'orderedList', '|', 'link']}
      placeholder="Type notes or use Markdown shortcuts like **bold** or - list"
      aria-label="Terms summary"
    />
  );
}
```

### Read-only content display

Pass `readOnly={true}` to display saved HTML content safely without the editing chrome or toolbar.

```tsx
import { RichTextEditor } from '@innostes/ui/editor';

const savedHtml = '<p>Goods must be delivered to <strong>Bay 4</strong>.</p>';

export function ReadOnlyNotice() {
  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-3">
      <RichTextEditor
        value={savedHtml}
        readOnly
        aria-label="Saved instructions"
      />
    </div>
  );
}
```

### Tiptap extensions and editor instance

Pass custom extensions through the `extensions` prop, and access the raw Tiptap instance via `onReady` for advanced programmatic manipulation.

```tsx
import { RichTextEditor } from '@innostes/ui/editor';
import CharacterCount from '@tiptap/extension-character-count';
import type { Editor } from '@tiptap/react';

export function ExtendedEditor() {
  const handleReady = (editor: Editor) => {
    // Programmatic access to Tiptap editor API
    console.info('Editor initialized', editor.getHTML());
  };

  return (
    <RichTextEditor
      extensions={[CharacterCount.configure({ limit: 1000 })]}
      onReady={handleReady}
      aria-label="Character counted specification"
    />
  );
}
```

## Accessibility

`RichTextEditor` uses Base UI Toolbar primitives to provide an accessible formatting experience.

### Keyboard navigation

The toolbar forms a single tab stop with horizontal arrow navigation.

<KeyboardTable
  entries={[
    { key: 'Tab', action: 'Moves focus from the toolbar into the document editing canvas.' },
    { key: 'Left Arrow / Right Arrow', action: 'Navigates between formatting buttons within the toolbar.' },
    { key: 'Mod + B', action: 'Toggles bold on selected text (Cmd+B on macOS, Ctrl+B on Windows/Linux).' },
    { key: 'Mod + I', action: 'Toggles italic on selected text.' },
    { key: 'Mod + U', action: 'Toggles underline on selected text.' },
    { key: 'Mod + Shift + S', action: 'Toggles strikethrough formatting.' },
    { key: 'Mod + Shift + 8', action: 'Converts current paragraph to an unordered bulleted list.' },
    { key: 'Mod + Shift + 7', action: 'Converts current paragraph to an ordered numbered list.' },
    { key: 'Mod + Shift + B', action: 'Converts current block into a blockquote.' },
    { key: 'Mod + E', action: 'Toggles inline code formatting.' },
    { key: 'Mod + Z', action: 'Undoes the previous editing action.' },
    { key: 'Mod + Shift + Z', action: 'Redoes the previously undone editing action.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers

- Formatting buttons include descriptive `aria-label` attributes and stateful `aria-pressed` values indicating whether the active selection carries that style.
- The link configuration popover traps focus until applied or dismissed with Escape.
- Form validation errors are associated with the editor via `aria-describedby` when wrapped in a `Field`.

## Guidelines

<DoDont
  do={{
    description: 'Always sanitize user-submitted HTML on your server before persisting it or re-rendering it elsewhere.',
    code: `// Sanitize with DOMPurify or sanitize-html on server\nconst cleanHtml = sanitizeHtml(dirtyHtml, allowedTagsConfig);`,
  }}
  dont={{
    description: 'Never render saved HTML directly into other views using dangerouslySetInnerHTML without sanitisation.',
    code: `// INSECURE: Risk of cross-site scripting (XSS)\n<div dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: unverifiedPayload }} />`,
  }}
/>

<DoDont
  do={{
    description: 'Provide an accessible label using FieldLabel with id or aria-label so screen reader users understand the field purpose.',
    code: `<FieldLabel id="spec-label">Item specification</FieldLabel>\n<RichTextEditor aria-labelledby="spec-label" />`,
  }}
  dont={{
    description: 'Do not rely entirely on the placeholder text as the only descriptor of the required input.',
    code: `<RichTextEditor placeholder="Item specification" />`,
  }}
/>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['RichTextEditor']} />

## Related

- [Textarea](/ui/docs/components/forms/textarea) — Plain text multiline input for unformatted remarks.
- [Field](/ui/docs/components/forms/field) — Accessible field container with labels, descriptions, and error states.
- [Button](/ui/docs/components/actions/button) — Interactive button component.

## Searchable Select (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select)

Filterable single-select dropdown matching labels and keywords with accent-insensitive search.

`SearchableSelect` wraps an accessible listbox with a searchable text filter. It is designed for medium-length client-side option sets (15 to 100+ items) such as warehouse branches, account owners, country destinations, or currency codes where users benefit from typing to instantly narrow the list.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/searchable-select/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import { SearchableSelect, type SearchableSelectOption } from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use SearchableSelect** when selecting one option from a medium-sized list (15 to 100+ items) that can be filtered locally in the browser.
- **Use Combobox** when the dataset is very large (hundreds or thousands of records), requires asynchronous server pagination, or allows freeform user-created tags.
- **Use Select** when the list of options is small (under 15 items) and instant type-ahead suffices.
- **Use RadioGroup** when comparing 2 to 5 options side-by-side.

### Selection control comparison

| Control | Selection count | Number of options | Search filter | Best suited for |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **SearchableSelect** | Single | 15 to 100+ | Yes | Moderate lists requiring fast dropdown filter search (e.g. warehouse depot) |
| **[Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox)** | Single or Multi | 50 to 10,000+ | Yes | Large async remote datasets or autocomplete with custom item creation |
| **[Select](/ui/docs/components/forms/select)** | Single or Multi | 5 to 15 | No (type-ahead) | Compact predefined lists (e.g. status, payment terms) |
| **[RadioGroup](/ui/docs/components/forms/radio-group)** | Single | 2 to 5 | No | Visible choices where side-by-side comparison is essential |
| **[TagInput](/ui/docs/components/forms/tag-input)** | Multi | Variable | Yes | Categorical metadata, SKU keywords, and multi-tag filtering |

## Examples

### Basic usage

Provide an array of `SearchableSelectOption` objects with `value`, `label`, and optional `keywords`:

```tsx
const options: SearchableSelectOption[] = [
  { value: 'blr-hub', label: 'Bengaluru Central Hub', keywords: ['Karnataka', 'BLR'], trailing: 'Karnataka' },
  { value: 'bom-jnpt', label: 'Mumbai JNPT Logistics', keywords: ['Maharashtra', 'BOM'], trailing: 'Maharashtra' },
  { value: 'del-depot', label: 'Delhi NCR Freight Terminal', keywords: ['Delhi', 'DEL'], trailing: 'Delhi' },
];

<SearchableSelect
  options={options}
  value={selectedDepot}
  onValueChange={setSelectedDepot}
  placeholder="Search depot by name or state..."
  aria-label="Destination warehouse depot"
/>
```

### Leading icons and avatars

Options support custom `leading` React nodes (such as icons or avatars) that render inside both the dropdown menu and the collapsed trigger:

```tsx
const operatorOptions = operators.map((op) => ({
  value: op.id,
  label: op.name,
  trailing: op.role,
  leading: (
    <Avatar size="xs">
      <AvatarFallback>{op.initials}</AvatarFallback>
    </Avatar>
  ),
}));

<SearchableSelect options={operatorOptions} aria-label="Assign procurement officer" />
```

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'Enter / Space', action: 'Opens the filter popup when focused on the trigger; selects the highlighted option when open.' },
    { key: 'ArrowDown / ArrowUp', action: 'Cycles through filtered options sequentially.' },
    { key: 'Escape', action: 'Closes the search dropdown and restores focus to the trigger button.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **ARIA Combobox pattern**: Uses `role="combobox"` with `aria-expanded` and `aria-controls`.
- **Search filtering announcements**: Screen readers announce the count of matching options as the search string changes.

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Include common abbreviations and alternate names in the `keywords` array (e.g. `keywords: ['KA', 'Bangalore']`).
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never use `SearchableSelect` for massive collections of 1,000+ items that should be paginated on the server; use `Combobox` instead.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Provide an informative placeholder indicating what fields are searchable (e.g. "Search by depot code or city...").
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never omit the accessible label when placing `SearchableSelect` inside custom toolbars without a `<FieldLabel>`.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['SearchableSelect']} baseUi="combobox" />

## Related

- [Select](/ui/docs/components/forms/select) — Standard dropdown menu for short option sets.
- [Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox) — High-performance searchable autocomplete for massive datasets.
- [LocaleSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/locale-select) — Specialized country, currency, and timezone selectors.

## Select (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/select)

Accessible dropdown selection menu with groups, separators, multiple selection, type-ahead, and automatic Field wiring.

import { SelectPlayground } from '@/components/docs/select-playground';

`Select` displays a collapsed trigger button that opens a floating menu of options. Built on Base UI's select primitive, it supports type-ahead search, roving keyboard focus, group dividers, and multi-selection, while integrating directly into `<Field>` for validation.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/select/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import {
  Select,
  SelectTrigger,
  SelectValue,
  SelectContent,
  SelectItem,
  SelectGroup,
  SelectGroupLabel,
  SelectSeparator,
} from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use Select** when users need to choose from a predefined list of 5 to 15 items in a compact form layout.
- **Use RadioGroup** when choices are few (2 to 5) and comparing options side-by-side without opening a menu is beneficial.
- **Use SearchableSelect or Combobox** when the list contains more than 15 items or requires fast keyboard typing search.

### Selection control comparison

| Control | Selection count | Number of options | Search filter | Best suited for |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Select** | Single or Multi | 5 to 15 | No (type-ahead only) | Compact predefined lists (e.g. status, tax rate, payment terms) |
| **[RadioGroup](/ui/docs/components/forms/radio-group)** | Single | 2 to 5 | No | Visible choices where side-by-side comparison is essential |
| **[SearchableSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select)** | Single | 15 to 100+ | Yes | Long lists requiring keyboard search filtering (e.g. warehouse depot) |
| **[Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox)** | Single or Multi | 50 to 10,000+ | Yes | Large async remote datasets or autocomplete with custom item creation |
| **[TagInput](/ui/docs/components/forms/tag-input)** | Multi | Variable | Yes | Categorical metadata, SKU keywords, and multi-tag filtering |

## Examples

### Interactive playground

Experiment with select trigger sizes and disabled states:

<SelectPlayground />

### Grouped options with separators

Organize related choices using `SelectGroup` and `SelectSeparator`:

```tsx
<Select defaultValue="blr-central">
  <SelectTrigger aria-label="Depot">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select warehouse depot..." />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectGroup>
      <SelectGroupLabel>Karnataka Facilities</SelectGroupLabel>
      <SelectItem value="blr-central">Bengaluru Central Hub</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="whitefield">Whitefield Logistics Center</SelectItem>
    </SelectGroup>
    <SelectSeparator />
    <SelectGroup>
      <SelectGroupLabel>Maharashtra Facilities</SelectGroupLabel>
      <SelectItem value="mumbai-port">Mumbai JNPT Port Depot</SelectItem>
      <SelectItem value="pune-chakan">Pune Chakan Industrial Hub</SelectItem>
    </SelectGroup>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

### Multiple selection

Set `multiple` on the root `Select` component to allow choosing multiple items:

```tsx
const [selectedCurrencies, setSelectedCurrencies] = useState(['INR', 'USD']);

<Select multiple value={selectedCurrencies} onValueChange={setSelectedCurrencies}>
  <SelectTrigger aria-label="Settlement currencies">
    <SelectValue placeholder="Select currencies..." />
  </SelectTrigger>
  <SelectContent>
    <SelectItem value="INR">Indian Rupee (INR)</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="USD">US Dollar (USD)</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="EUR">Euro (EUR)</SelectItem>
    <SelectItem value="GBP">British Pound (GBP)</SelectItem>
  </SelectContent>
</Select>
```

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'Enter / Space', action: 'Opens the select menu when focused on the trigger; selects the highlighted item when open.' },
    { key: 'ArrowDown / ArrowUp', action: 'Navigates focus between menu items sequentially.' },
    { key: 'Home / End', action: 'Jumps directly to the first or last selectable option.' },
    { key: 'Type-ahead', action: 'Typing characters jumps focus directly to the matching option label.' },
    { key: 'Escape', action: 'Dismisses the open dropdown menu and returns focus to the trigger button.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **`role="combobox"`**: Emitted on `<SelectTrigger>` alongside `aria-expanded` and `aria-haspopup="listbox"`.
- **`role="listbox"` & `role="option"`**: Assigned to the content popup and individual items.
- **Active descendant**: Communicates the currently focused option to screen readers using standard ARIA patterns.

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Use `Select` for bounded, predictable lists where users already know what options to expect.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never use `Select` for massive datasets (e.g. 500+ postal codes); use `Combobox` or `SearchableSelect` instead.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Provide an informative placeholder on `<SelectValue placeholder="Select supplier..." />`.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never leave the trigger blank when no default value is selected.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable
  components={[
    'Select',
    'SelectTrigger',
    'SelectValue',
    'SelectContent',
    'SelectItem',
    'SelectGroup',
    'SelectGroupLabel',
    'SelectSeparator',
  ]}
  baseUi="select"
/>

- [SearchableSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select) — Filterable dropdown selection for longer lists.
- [Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox) — High-performance autocomplete input with virtualized options.
- [RadioGroup](/ui/docs/components/forms/radio-group) — Mutually exclusive visible option cards.

## Slider (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/slider)

Accessible slider component supporting single values, dual-thumb price ranges, keyboard stepping, and form submission.

`Slider` allows users to select a single numerical value or a bounded numerical range by dragging thumbs along a horizontal track or adjusting values via keyboard arrows. Built on Base UI's slider primitive, it supports dual-thumb range filtering, custom stepping, and automatic accessibility announcements.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/slider/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import { Slider } from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use Slider** for selecting approximate numeric values along a continuous range (e.g. percentage volumes, price range filters, inspection sample thresholds).
- **Use NumberField** when exact numerical precision is required (e.g. entering invoice currency totals or unit quantities).
- **Use Progress or Meter** when displaying a read-only visual measurement without user dragging interaction.

## Examples

### Single value slider

Select a discrete numeric value along a defined boundary:

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Warehouse humidity threshold (%)</FieldLabel>
  <Slider defaultValue={45} min={20} max={80} step={5} aria-label="Humidity threshold" />
</Field>
```

### Dual-thumb range selection

Pass an array of two numbers (`[min, max]`) to enable dual-thumb range mode:

```tsx
const [priceRange, setPriceRange] = useState<number[]>([2500, 8000]);

<div className="space-y-2">
  <div className="flex justify-between text-sm font-medium">
    <span>Procurement budget</span>
    <span className="font-mono text-muted-foreground">₹{priceRange[0]} – ₹{priceRange[1]}</span>
  </div>
  <Slider
    value={priceRange}
    onValueChange={(val) => setPriceRange(val as number[])}
    min={1000}
    max={15000}
    step={250}
    thumbLabels={['Minimum budget rate', 'Maximum budget rate']}
  />
</div>
```

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'ArrowRight / ArrowUp', action: 'Increments the slider value by one step.' },
    { key: 'ArrowLeft / ArrowDown', action: 'Decrements the slider value by one step.' },
    { key: 'PageUp', action: 'Increments the slider value by largeStep.' },
    { key: 'PageDown', action: 'Decrements the slider value by largeStep.' },
    { key: 'Home', action: 'Jumps directly to the minimum bound value.' },
    { key: 'End', action: 'Jumps directly to the maximum bound value.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **`role="slider"`**: Emitted on each thumb element.
- **ARIA synchronization**: Exposes `aria-valuenow`, `aria-valuemin`, and `aria-valuemax`.
- **`thumbLabels` requirement**: In dual-thumb range mode, `thumbLabels` **must** be provided so screen readers announce which thumb is being adjusted (e.g. `thumbLabels={['Minimum rate', 'Maximum rate']}`).

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Always display the currently selected value numerically beside the slider when exact figures matter to the operator.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never use `Slider` without a visible numerical readout when users need to select precise monetary amounts.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Provide descriptive `thumbLabels` for dual-thumb range sliders.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never allow the minimum thumb to cross past the maximum thumb; `@innostes/ui` automatically clamps thumbs to prevent inversion.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['Slider']} baseUi="slider" />

## Related

- [NumberField](/ui/docs/components/forms/number-field) — Typed numerical input with precision steppers.
- [Progress](/ui/docs/components/feedback/progress) — Read-only task progress bar.
- [Meter](/ui/docs/components/feedback/meter) — Read-only capacity and quota gauge.

## Switch (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/switch)

Accessible binary switch primitive with animated thumb sliding, sizes, and instant state synchronization.

import { SwitchPlayground } from '@/components/docs/switch-playground';

`Switch` provides a physical toggle slider for binary configuration options. Built on Base UI's switch primitive, it emits `role="switch"` semantics and smooth CSS sliding transitions. It is designed for preferences and live operational flags (e.g. enabling automatic replenishment) where changes activate immediately without a manual save step.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/switch/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import { Switch } from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use Switch** for standalone configuration toggles that apply immediately (e.g. "Dark mode", "SMS dispatch alerts").
- **Use Checkbox** for form fields where selections require an explicit "Submit" button, or when multi-item table selection is required.
- **Use Toggle** for styling buttons inside rich text toolbars or view filters.

## Examples

### Interactive playground

Experiment with switch sizes, states, and disabled attributes:

<SwitchPlayground />

### Inside a field with description

Pair the switch with a clear label and operational explanation:

```tsx
<Field>
  <label className="flex items-start gap-3 cursor-pointer">
    <Switch name="autoReorder" defaultChecked className="mt-0.5" />
    <div>
      <span className="text-sm font-medium text-foreground">
        Automated replenishment
      </span>
      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        Automatically draft purchase orders when inventory falls below minimum buffer.
      </p>
    </div>
  </label>
</Field>
```

### Sizes

Switches are available in `sm` and `md` (default) sizes:

```tsx
<Switch size="sm" aria-label="Compact switch" />
<Switch size="md" aria-label="Default switch" />
```

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'Space', action: 'Toggles the switch between on (checked) and off (unchecked).' },
    { key: 'Enter', action: 'Toggles the switch state in standard browser form contexts.' },
    { key: 'Tab', action: 'Moves focus to or away from the switch element.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **`role="switch"`**: Emitted automatically to ensure assistive technologies announce "switch, on" or "switch, off" rather than generic checkboxes.
- **`aria-checked`**: Synchronized dynamically with the active state.
- **Required labelling**: Ensure the switch is enclosed within a `<label>` or provided an explicit `aria-label`.

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Use `Switch` when toggling the setting takes immediate effect in the system.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never use `Switch` in standard forms where the user must still click an external "Save" or "Submit" button; use `Checkbox` instead.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Pair the switch with clear textual labels that explain what feature is enabled when turned on.
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never change the label text based on state (e.g. changing "Off" to "On"); keep the label static.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['Switch']} baseUi="switch" />

## Related

- [Checkbox](/ui/docs/components/forms/checkbox) — Standard checkbox for form agreements.
- [Toggle](/ui/docs/components/actions/toggle) — Two-state pressed button.
- [RadioGroup](/ui/docs/components/forms/radio-group) — Mutually exclusive multi-option selection.

## Tag Input (https://innostes.com/ui/docs/components/forms/tag-input)

Removable chip tag entry control supporting autocomplete suggestions, delimiter pasting, maximum bounds, and validation.

`TagInput` captures and organizes multiple keywords, product SKUs, tax categories, or email recipients as removable chips. Built on Base UI's multi-select Combobox primitive, it supports comma-separated text pasting, custom tag validation, maximum limits, and keyboard arrow traversal across existing tags.

<ComponentPreview name="forms/tag-input/basic" />

## Import

```tsx
import { TagInput } from '@innostes/ui';
```

## When to use

- **Use TagInput** when users need to assign multiple freeform or suggested tags (such as product categories, logistics tags, or notification recipients).
- **Use Combobox** when selecting items from a large database where items represent fixed single entities.
- **Use Select** with `multiple` when users pick from a small fixed list of options without typing custom tags.

### Selection control comparison

| Control | Selection count | Number of options | Search filter | Best suited for |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **TagInput** | Multi | Variable | Yes | Categorical metadata, SKU keywords, and multi-tag filtering |
| **[Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox)** | Single or Multi | 50 to 10,000+ | Yes | Large async remote datasets or autocomplete with custom item creation |
| **[SearchableSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select)** | Single | 15 to 100+ | Yes | Moderate lists requiring fast dropdown filter search |
| **[Select](/ui/docs/components/forms/select)** | Single or Multi | 5 to 15 | No (type-ahead) | Compact predefined lists (e.g. status, payment terms) |
| **[RadioGroup](/ui/docs/components/forms/radio-group)** | Single | 2 to 5 | No | Visible choices where side-by-side comparison is essential |

## Examples

### Autocomplete suggestions with limits

Limit the total number of allowed tags and suggest existing values:

```tsx
const departmentTags = ['Procurement', 'Inventory', 'GST Compliance', 'Logistics', 'Quality Audit'];

<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Operational tags</FieldLabel>
  <TagInput
    suggestions={departmentTags}
    defaultValue={['Procurement', 'GST Compliance']}
    placeholder="Add tag (e.g. Logistics)..."
    max={5}
    aria-label="Department tags"
  />
  <FieldDescription>Maximum 5 tags allowed per consignment.</FieldDescription>
</Field>
```

### Custom tag validation and pasting

Enforce regex pattern validation on tags and parse comma-delimited clipboard text:

```tsx
<Field>
  <FieldLabel>Notification recipients</FieldLabel>
  <TagInput
    placeholder="officer@northwind.in..."
    validate={(tag) => /^\S+@\S+\.\S+$/.test(tag)}
    delimiters={[',', ';', ' ']}
    aria-label="Notification email addresses"
  />
  <FieldDescription>Type or paste comma-separated corporate email addresses.</FieldDescription>
</Field>
```

### Closed suggestion lists

Set `allowCustom={false}` to restrict selections exclusively to predefined suggestions:

```tsx
<TagInput
  allowCustom={false}
  suggestions={['Warehouse-A', 'Warehouse-B', 'Transit-Hub']}
  placeholder="Select warehouse zones..."
/>
```

## Accessibility

### Keyboard navigation

<KeyboardTable
  rows={[
    { key: 'Enter / Comma', action: 'Converts current input text into a committed tag chip.' },
    { key: 'ArrowLeft', action: 'From the start of the text input, moves focus backward into the preceding tag chips.' },
    { key: 'ArrowRight', action: 'Moves focus forward across tags back to the text entry field.' },
    { key: 'Backspace / Delete', action: 'Removes the currently focused tag chip, or removes the last tag when input is empty.' },
  ]}
/>

### Screen readers and ARIA

- **Combobox & Listbox roles**: The text input operates as `role="combobox"` controlling an ARIA listbox popup for suggestions.
- **Accessible removal buttons**: Each chip contains an inline dismissal button labelled via `removeLabel` (defaults to `"Remove <tag>"`).

## Guidelines

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Provide an informative `placeholder` and helper description explaining how to commit tags (e.g. "Press Enter or comma to add").
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never use `TagInput` when users can only pick one single value; use `Select` or `SearchableSelect` instead.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

<DoDont>
  <Do>
    Use `validate` to reject malformed input strings (such as invalid email formats or disallowed characters).
  </Do>
  <Dont>
    Never allow duplicate tags; `@innostes/ui` automatically deduplicates entries case-insensitively.
  </Dont>
</DoDont>

## API reference

<ApiTable components={['TagInput']} />

## Related

- [Combobox](/ui/docs/components/forms/combobox) — Autocomplete input with floating listbox results.
- [SearchableSelect](/ui/docs/components/forms/searchable-select) — Filterable dropdown selector.
- [Badge](/ui/docs/components/data-display/badge) — Static metadata and status indicators.
